title: Piggy Bank Decisions
subtitle: Save, Spend, or Share — you decide!
description: Sort 10 money decisions into the right piggy bank bucket: Save, Spend, or Share. Learn that every coin is a choice.
learning_objectives: Understand the difference between saving, spending, and sharing money
Practice making thoughtful decisions about small purchases
Recognise that sharing money is a form of generosity
reflection_prompt: Which bucket was hardest to decide? What made it tricky to choose?
coaching_moment: Every time you decide what to do with money, you are practising a skill that will help you your whole life.

buckets.name: Save
buckets.description: Put money away for later — a future goal or emergency

buckets.name: Spend
buckets.description: Buy something you need or want right now

buckets.name: Share
buckets.description: Give some money to help others
